name: Hornero Agenda
description: Agenda: desktop widget of date facts from PluginKit Time (weekday, ISO week and week-year, day of year, remaining days, year progress) with Desktop Widgets 2.0 size classes, per-display slot display and hide-with-restore. No events backend.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Desktop Widgets 2.0 (#32): manifest v2 with the desktop surface redeclared on the same entrypoint, read-only Desktop.position slot and display shown in a host-owned popover, persisted compact/standard/wide size class and hide-with-restore visibility as typed settings (defaults standard/visible, so 2.0 content is unchanged), and reset for size and visibility. Moving stays in Control Center: PluginKit has no slot setter.

Time and Agenda 2.0: the 1.x date facts as labelled metrics plus quarter, ISO week-year, days remaining in the month and a year-progress bar, locale-correct dates and numbers, typed row settings with 1.x defaults and Argentine Spanish catalog. No events are shown: PluginKit has no calendar data source.
Desktop widget showing weekday, day and month, ISO week number, day of year and days remaining in the year, computed with pure Date math from PluginKit Time.

showIsoWeek.description: Show the ISO week and week-year row (the 1.x behaviour).

showYearProgress.description: Show the elapsed fraction of the year as a progress bar.

sizeClass.description: Desktop widget size class within the host width cap (300 logical px today); standard keeps the 2.0 size. This sizes content, not the slot.

showOnDesktop.description: Show the widget content on the desktop (the 2.0 behaviour). Off leaves a visible Show widget button so the content can always be restored.
